messages.content: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, then get the USD to EUR exchange rate and show me the AAPL quote profile converted from USD to EUR. For the converted quote, please include price 120.5 EUR and price_usd 131.2. After that, for user_123, find similar audio products to product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, which is the Sony WH-1000XM5 Black, choose one suitable option in the audio category for quantity 1, and place a hold on it. Then confirm the order. Finally, generate an invoice for these items: [{ product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1 }], using coupon code SAVE15, for quantity 1, and send it to alice@company.com using payment_method paypal through payment_gateway paypal.
